newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Local institutional buying drives Zimbabwe stocks.
newsitem.headline: Local institutional buying drives Zimbabwe stocks.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares rose on Thursday driven by local institutional buying and climbing 22.77 points to close at 6,948.39.

"The big local players are all over the market, buying this and that. Although we had some price-correction in the past few days, the pressure may see prices back at the old levels again," one broker said.

"The overall assessment, I think, is that there is everything to gain getting in. What more, the other big market is pointing to shares," he said in reference to falling rates on the local money market which has boosted trade on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange.

The exchange's 57-share industrial index was driven up on Thursday by several counters, including bluechip conglomerate Delta, banking group Finhold and Zimbabwe Sugar Refineries (ZSR) which gained 50 cents to 3,200, 35 cents to 925 and 50 cents to 1,250 respectively.
Nickel miner Bindura traded 75 cents higher at 1,225 and was the main power behind the secondary seven-share mining index's 6.32 jump to 1,353.11.
